# container-timing-pre-paint-traversal

Runs the Container Timing Web Platform Tests with the
`ContainerTimingPrepaintTraversal` feature enabled, exercising the pre-paint
attribution tracker path instead of the legacy per-paint DOM traversal.

See crbug.com/489959278.
